projectState.summary: Track D3 is implemented on codex/byte-d3-iterating-loop and ready for Claude review. runCandidateCycle now scores developed children with scoreProsody -> aggregateCandidateFitness({ kind:'phrase' }) -> scoreCandidate, skips no-op development instead of aborting, and runEvolution runs bounded deterministic multi-generation phrase cycles with top/mean elite fitness summaries exposed through window.persistence.runEvolution(). Observed seed 4242 run improved top fitness 0.6317 -> 0.7945 -> 0.7945 -> 0.8199. Validation passed build, smoke, db:smoke, and diff-check; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories. Carry forward: branch-scoped candidate ids before parallel populations, shared/recomputed B2 operators before trusted provenance, and future diversity lever if longer runs converge too early.
